journey.name: lnurl scanned inside send keeps its route and amount
journey.description: Use the funded regtest E2E setup and variable/fixed LNURL fixtures described in scanner-pay-lifecycle.xml. Quick Pay must be off. This covers an ordinary Send presentation whose initial route stays options while recipient input adds payment routes. Use Paste Invoice, which reaches the same Send scan handler; ordinary Send has no ScanPrompt control. The entry steps were corrected after the original J2 was blocked. Do not authorize a payment. The production-host unit regressions force content recreation to verify the retained navigation, amount draft and final cleanup.

actions.action: Record the Quick Pay enabled state, disable it if needed, verify it is off, and return home without changing its limits
Open Send (id "Send") and verify recipient options are visible
Set the simulator clipboard to the variable LNURL fixture and tap Paste Invoice (id "RecipientInvoice") inside Send
Verify "SendNumberField" and "ContinueAmount" are visible, enter 150 sats and tap "ContinueAmount"
Verify "ReviewAmount-primary" shows 150 and "CommentInput" is visible; do not swipe to pay
Navigate back to the LNURL amount screen and verify "SendNumberField" still shows the entered 150 sats, then continue and verify the 150-sat confirmation again
Close the payment and open a fresh Send; verify recipient options appear without the previous LNURL amount or comment
Set the simulator clipboard to the fixed 500500-msat fixture and tap "RecipientInvoice"; verify "ReviewAmount-primary" shows 501, "CommentInput" is absent and no amount-entry step is required
Close all Send sheets, restore the recorded Quick Pay enabled state, verify it, and return home
